boundary_effect.reason: No matched counterfactual with identical fixed72 horizon/scenario pool/tail rule but full outstanding-contract continuation. Midnight-vs-fixed48 also changes actual horizon and mature history; fixed48-vs-fixed72 changes future deliveries/history/tail price interval. selection_scope: Retrospective January moment diagnosis. Fixed historical forecast families were selected using Jan15-31, overlapping both reported windows. No Feb-Dec observations used in these moment calculations; this is not unbiased held-out validation, and beta_star is an in-sample MSE optimum, not a bill optimum or replacement for beta=.75.
